correctness.rationale: Independently rebuilt H from the (0,1,3) Fano incidence rule; enumerated all 1001 four-sets, finding 98 connected, 903 disconnected. Generated all 15,816 faces and complete face vector. Reimplemented exact stagewise face-toggle matching and verified all 108,416 oriented Hasse covers admit a complete topological order, leaving precisely 188 critical 9-cells and no other augmented critical face. Forman discrete Morse therefore yields the claimed integral wedge, not merely sampled homology.
